tokens.title: Deploy tokens
tokens.description: API tokens that CI runners use to push deployments to {slug}. Plaintext is shown once at create/rotate; we store only the hash.

createSheet.title: Create deploy token
createSheet.description: The plaintext secret is shown once on the next screen — copy it into your CI secret store immediately.
createSheet.name: Name

revealDialog.title: Token created — copy now
revealDialog.description: This is the only time the plaintext secret will be shown. Paste it into your CI secret store immediately.
revealDialog.graceNote: Previous secret stays valid for {window} — in-flight CI runs will not fail.

rotateDialog.title: Rotate {name}?
rotateDialog.graceLine: Old token remains valid for {window} — in-flight CI runs will not fail.
rotateDialog.immediateHint: Use Revoke for an immediate cutover after a suspected compromise.

revokeDialog.title: Revoke {name}?
revokeDialog.description: CI flows holding this token break immediately. Mint a new token afterwards and update the CI secret. Use Rotate instead for a grace-period swap.

addSheet.byoFollowup: Hostname is still validated via DNS-TXT. After it goes live, upload your certificate via the per-domain Replace action below.

methodHints.dns_txt: Default. Operator adds a TXT record at _astrolift-challenge.<hostname>.
methodHints.http_01: ACME HTTP-01 challenge served from the cluster's ingress controller. Pick this when DNS edits are slow.
methodHints.dns_01: ACME DNS-01 challenge. Required for wildcards and zones where ACM / cloud cert manager handles the records.
methodHints.byo_cert: Skip ACME entirely. Validate via DNS-TXT, then paste your own PEM chain + private key.
